title: DetailViewStyle group-3 text-color insertion fast slice
scope: Serialize a changed DetailViewStyle view-label text color when group 3 is absent from the captured source.
Enforce the signed 16-bit DXF color range and preserve aligned ASCII raw lexemes/Binary placeholders.
Verify typed same-version ASCII and Binary readback without adding repository fixtures or a CTest registration.

implementation.behavior: The copied DetailViewStyle raw carrier inserts group 62 in style group 3 when the typed view-label color differs from the class default and is absent from the source. The value is checked against the signed 16-bit range before insertion.
implementation.generatedControl: The secondary DetailViewStyle omits its full group-3 block. The test confirms the parsed color default is 256, edits it to 17, and verifies the complete expected raw group stream and typed ASCII/Binary readback; the same control verifies insertion of the style's group-3 text-style reference.

limitations: Only same-version generated DXF insertion of this single-occurrence color field is covered.
Other absent fields and changed repeated-field cardinality remain fail-closed.
No DWG-origin typed output, cross-version translation, native style rendering, or consumer support qualification follows.
